content.body:
title = Basic Rifleman Training
20mhit = 20 m target hit! 50mhit = 50 m target hit! 100mhit = 100 m target hit! Good shooting. 200mhit = 200 m target hit! Well done! 500mhit = 500 m target hit! Excellent!
1.0.label = The Rifle
1.1.alert.modal = Welcome to the basic rifleman tutorial. You will learn about your equipment and how to fire your rifle. 1.1.alert1 = Move to the nearby infantry firing range, which is indicated by a waypoint on your minimap.[NL][NL]Or just follow the arrow in the center of your screen. 1.1.alert1.hilite = minimap 1.1.label = Move to the firing position
1.2.alert = Your primary weapon is the bolt-action rifle. While slow firing, rifles are very accurate and do significant damage. By default, your rifle is at rest.[NL][NL]Try firing at a target down range with {fpfire}. 1.2.label = Your First Shot 1.2.complete.modal = As you can see, it is difficult to hit anything precisely when shooting from the hip.
1.3.alert.modal = You will automatically cycle the next round if your weapon is not empty. When you run out of ammo, you will hear a click when you try to fire and see "0" displayed in your ammo counter. 1.3.alert1 = As you fire off rounds in this tutorial, keep an eye on your ammo and clip counter. Fire off a few more rounds at the targets down range with {fpfire}.[NL][NL]Reload your rifle with {fpreload} when you are ready to continue. 1.3.alert1.hilite = primary 1.3.label = Fire and Reload 1.3.complete.modal = Your rifle now has ammo again. You can reload your weapon at any time, even if there are rounds remaining in the clip.
1.4.alert.modal = To be successful with a rifle, you must learn to aim. As you aim, you will take a breath to keep your weapon steady. The longer you hold the aim, the harder it will be to keep the weapon still.[NL][NL]To watch the impact of your rounds, continue to hold down {fpfire} when you fire. This will help you correct your aim. 1.4.alert1 = Shoot any target by aiming {fpgunsight} and firing {fpfire}. Score 3 aimed hits to continue. 1.4.label = Aimed Fire 1.4.complete = Excellent, using your gunsights in combat is very important.
1.5.label = Gunsight Range 1.5.alert.modal = Rifles have adjustable sights for firing at different distances. The default range setting for rifles is 200 meters, but infantry combat can take place inside and outside of this range. 1.5.alert.hilite = primary-label 1.5.alert1.modal = Take a moment to fire different targets with different range settings to see how it affects your accuracy. Use {gunsightrangeinc} and {gunsightrangedec} to increase and decrease your range setting. 1.5.alert1.hilite = primary-label 1.5.complete = Adjusting your gunsight range will give you the best chance of hitting your target.
2.0.label = Switching Weapons
2.1.alert.modal = As a Rifleman you carry 6 items into combat. Switching items is usually done with the number keys or the mouse wheel. The weapon indicator shows your currently equipped weapon or item. 2.1.alert.hilite = primary 2.1.alert1 = You have already used your rifle, now examine your other equipment.[NL][NL]Select your HE grenade with the {fpweapon1} key. 2.1.label = Select HE Grenade
2.2.alert = Select your smoke grenade with the {fpweapon2} key. 2.2.label = Select Smoke Grenade
2.3.alert = Select your combat knife with the {fpweapon3} key. 2.3.label = Select Combat Knife
2.4.alert = Select your High Explosive satchel pack with the {fpweapon4} key. 2.4.label = Select High Explosive Satchel
2.5.alert = Select your ammo pack with the {fpweapon5} key. 2.5.label = Select Ammo Pack 2.5.complete = Well done! Quickly changing weapons can save your life!
3.0.label = Grenades
3.1.alert = Grenades are an important infantry weapon you must understand to use well. Most infantry classes carry both high explosive and smoke grenades.[NL][NL]Select your smoke grenade with the {fpweapon2} key. 3.1.label = Select Smoke Grenade
3.2.alert.modal = Smoke grenades help conceal your movements from enemy fire, especially when other concealment is not available. But they also draw the enemy's attention, so use them wisely. 3.2.alert1.modal = To throw a grenade, press and hold down {fpfire}. The longer you hold {fpfire}, the farther you will throw the grenade. After a few seconds, you will automatically throw the grenade at full power. 3.2.alert2 = To aim your throw, simply look in that direction. For greater distance, aim your throw at an upward angle so that it will arc through the air.[NL][NL]Throw your smoke grenade by pressing and holding {fpfire}. 3.2.label = Throw Smoke Grenade 3.2.complete = Good. Watch the smoke released from the grenade to understand how much concealment each grenade will provide and the duration it will burn.
3.3.alert = Warning! You can be killed by your own high explosive ("HE") grenades so be careful when throwing them! Always throw HE grenades from behind cover or far enough that it won't hurt you.[NL][NL]Select an explosive grenade with the {fpweapon1} key. 3.3.label = Select HE Grenade
3.4.alert = Throwing HE grenades is the same as throwing smoke grenades - except that they can kill you![NL][NL]Aim slightly high then press and hold {fpfire} to throw your HE grenade. 3.4.label = Throw HE Grenade 3.4.complete = Good. Remember, if you release your grenade too soon, run and drop prone for safety!
4.0.label = Combat Knife
4.1.alert = To kill enemies with stealth or when you run out of other ammo, you can use your combat knife. Simply get close and thrust using {fpfire}.[NL][NL]Select your combat knife with the {fpweapon3} key. 4.1.label = Select Combat Knife
4.2.alert = Press {fpfire} to thrust your knife. 4.2.label = Use Your Knife 4.2.complete = Remember, you must be very close to an opponent to strike him with this weapon.
5.0.label = Ammo Resupply Pack
5.1.alert = Riflemen and most paratrooper units carry an Ammo Pack. Using this item on a friendly player will resupply their ammunition.[NL][NL]Select your ammo resupply pack with the {fpweapon5} key. 5.1.label = Select Ammo Pack
5.2.alert = For mortarmen and machine gunners, ammo is very precious. A good idea might be to wait until one of these infantry types near you needs ammo before expending your pack.[NL][NL]Press {fpfire} to see your ammo pack in action. 5.2.label = Use Ammo Pack 5.2.complete = Good. If a teammate were present, they would have received it.
5.3.alert.modal = You can request ammunition from other players by entering the command "/ammo" into the chat interface. If you have an ammo pack, you will see the icon of other players who request ammo flash in the game and on the game map.
5.3.alert1.modal = You can also gain ammunition from trucks and halftracks. Any ground vehicle or infantry unit close to a stationary truck will regain ammunition, a small truck icon is shown when you are in range. The resupply takes a few moments. Stand near the truck to see the this.
# Script-fu: Waypoint at resupply truck with radius same as resupply icon range
5.3.alert2.modal = Good. Notice the resupply icon is flashing and that your ammunition is being replaced. You cannot have more ammunition than you started it - only spent ammunition can be replaced.
# Script-fu:HUD highlight box on flashing resupply icon
5.3.label = End Tutorial 5.3.complete.modal = Congratulations! That completes your Basic Weapon Training!
content.brief: An introduction to the weapons and equipment of the infantry rifleman.
content.title: Basic Rifle Training
